headline: US Voters Signal Opposition to Data Center Expansion
summary: Voters in several US cities expressed opposition to the proliferation of data centers during recent midterm elections, signaling potential regulatory hurdles for future infrastructure development.
why: Data centers are essential for the AI and cloud computing boom; local opposition could increase costs and delay expansion for major technology firms.

impacts.name: Data Center Industry
impacts.why: Increased local opposition and potential bans create regulatory risk and operational uncertainty for tech infrastructure.
